feat: canonical BCP 47 platform regions (#53)

* feat(hawk): make Aviary regions canonical BCP 47 region tags

Replace free-form region codes with an ICU-validated allowlist, expand/contract Postgres onto region_tag (mapping default to zh-CN and halting on unknown history), and bind object storage plus app regions to that key while leaving cloud providerRegion independent.

* chore: regenerate OpenAPI clients for regionTag

Refresh the generated management client so platform regions, storage profiles, and language packs speak regionTag and providerRegion instead of logicalRegion.

* feat(robin): use fixed settings paths and BCP 47 region tags

Split platform settings onto General, Developer, Regions, and Object storage URLs with no query-section compatibility, move App regions under the tenant workspace, and bind storage plus localization to regionTag.

* docs: describe BCP 47 platform regions in OpenWiki

Record that Aviary region identity is regionTag, object storage binds by that tag with an independent providerRegion, and Robin settings use fixed paths without section-query compatibility.

* fix: project app region permissions into tenant sessions

Tenant administrators already receive platform.app_regions grants, but Hawk omitted those keys from session probes and Robin ignored tenant-scoped copies, so the App regions page stayed inaccessible.
